web_search.promptSnippet: Search the web for current facts, docs, APIs, releases, or external errors.
promptGuidelines: Use web_search only when current/external evidence is needed.
Prefer official docs, source repos, changelogs, and package registries.
Cite source URLs in plan or final answer.

web_fetch.promptSnippet: Fetch a specific URL and read source content.
promptGuidelines: Fetch primary sources before making claims.
Use raw:true only when page source matters.
Use GitHub interceptor for github.com repo/file URLs when enabled.
Cite fetched URLs in plan or final answer.
